name: Cable Twisting Standing High Row
how_to:
Cable Twisting Standing High Row / Benefits
- This exercise, performed with a cable machine or resistance band, is a compound exercise that works all the back muscles.
- The rotational movement in this exercise causes many muscle groups to work. As you rotate your body, your legs take more power from your glutes to support your body. Meanwhile, it allows the hip muscles, adductors and many deeper smaller muscle groups to work. While standing, both spinal rotation and hip rotation contribute to the rotation of the body.
